DeepSingleReadSNV.FeatureMapPrep.FilterI.description: Base file name for output files.
Number of cpus to use for this task. Default is 4.
Size of the local disk to use for this task, in GB. By default it is calculated from the input file sizes.
Regions to exclude from the output vcf. Supported formats are bed, bed.gz, vcf, vcf.gz. VCF exclusion is done using bcftools view -T ^regions, by position and not by ref and alt.
Regions to include in the output vcf. Supported formats are bed, bed.gz. Inclusion is done using 'bcftools view -T'.
Amount of memory to use for this task, in GB. Default is 4 (GB).

DeepSingleReadSNV.annotation_files.description: Annotation files for featuremap generation: dbSNP, gnomAD, and UG High Confidence Regions with their indices

DeepSingleReadSNV.base_file_name.description: Base file name for output files

DeepSingleReadSNV.deep_srsnv_params.description: Deep SRSNV (DNN) parameters. Controls training hyperparameters, fold count, GPU resources, and inference backend.

DeepSingleReadSNV.exclude_from_training_.description: INFO field name for the exclude-from-training annotation in the featuremap VCF.

DeepSingleReadSNV.featuremap_params.description: FeatureMap parameters, recommended value set in the template.

DeepSingleReadSNV.features.description: Features to be used for the report quality plots, should match the XGBoost feature set.

DeepSingleReadSNV.include_in_inference_f.description: INFO field name for the include-in-inference annotation in the featuremap VCF.

DeepSingleReadSNV.include_vcf_bcftools_f.description: Bcftools filter arguments applied to include-in-inference VCFs before annotation.

DeepSingleReadSNV.inference_models.description: Pre-trained N-fold model for mode='inference_only'. fold_metadata (recalibrated), fold_checkpoints, and fold_onnx_models are REQUIRED (engine rebuilt from ONNX in-runtime); fold_engines optional. Fold count inferred from the arrays.

DeepSingleReadSNV.input_featuremap_vcf.description: (inference_only) Pre-computed FeatureMap VCF. If provided, CreateFeatureMap is skipped and inference runs directly on it.

DeepSingleReadSNV.input_featuremap_vcf_i.description: (inference_only) Index for input_featuremap_vcf. Required if input_featuremap_vcf is provided.

DeepSingleReadSNV.mean_coverage.description: (Optional) Mean coverage value. Provide together with total_aligned_bases and without sorter_json_stats_file_list.

DeepSingleReadSNV.mode.description: Pipeline mode (set in the input template): 'full' (train + inference), 'train_only' (training + QC report), 'inference_only' (apply provided model, requires inference_models), or 'data_prep_only' (produce training tensor caches and stop).

DeepSingleReadSNV.num_shards_featuremap.description: Number of genomic shards to scatter the snvfind (CreateFeatureMap) step across. Higher values reduce wall-clock time but add scatter overhead.

DeepSingleReadSNV.override_memory_gb_Cre.description: Override memory in GB for the CreateFeatureMap task. If an out of memory error occurs, try increasing this value.

DeepSingleReadSNV.override_memory_gb_Pre.description: Override memory in GB for the PrepareRandomSampleFeatureMap task. If an out of memory error occurs, try increasing this value.
Override memory in GB for the PrepareRawFeatureMap task. If an out of memory error occurs, try increasing this value.

DeepSingleReadSNV.pcawg_field_name.description: INFO field name for the PCAWG annotation in the featuremap VCF.

DeepSingleReadSNV.raise_exceptions_in_re.description: Raise an exception and fail the pipeline if an error is raised in the QC report

DeepSingleReadSNV.random_sample_trinuc_f.description: (Optional) CSV or TSV file with trinucleotide frequencies for the random sample.

DeepSingleReadSNV.reference_genome.description: Genome type selector. The workflow currently supports only hg38.

DeepSingleReadSNV.scatter_interval_list.description: Interval list defining the genomic regions to scatter snvfind across. Should match the regions in featuremap_params.bed_file.

DeepSingleReadSNV.single_read_snv_params.description: SingleReadSNV parameters for training set preparation.

DeepSingleReadSNV.sorter_json_stats_file.description: (Optional) Sorter json stats files. Provide EITHER these files OR both mean_coverage and total_aligned_bases.

DeepSingleReadSNV.total_aligned_bases.description: (Optional) Total aligned bases used for downsampling rate calculation.
